title: BGS — DERIVED_VARIABLES table
description: Array of Generations Study baseline records. One element is one participant's baseline (R0) analysis-ready derived variables, keyed by TCode. Missing values are the in-band code -999 and structural not-applicable values the code 9999, so the dataset stays rectangular.
$comment: Standard JSON Schema cannot enforce uniqueness of TCode across rows or the arithmetic behind the derived measures (for example BMI = weight / height squared). See the README's 'Documented but not enforced' section once written.

allOf.$comment: Skip pattern R001: pregnant at age 20 means BMI at 20 is structurally not applicable. Source (R0_BMI20 x-description): 'If AgeEntry < 20 or R0_PregAt20 == 1, BMI is set to 9999.' Pair confirmed as D022; the AgeEntry < 20 half is not enforceable (D013).

Applicability R001: not pregnant at age 20 (R0_PregAt20 = 0) means BMI at 20 must not carry the not-applicable code, because the source sets R0_PregAt20 to 9999 when AgeEntry < 20, so 0 implies the participant was 20 or over (D022).

Skip pattern R002: pregnant at baseline means BMI and waist-hip ratio are structurally not applicable. Source: 'If R0_CurrentPreg == 1, BMI is set to 9999' (same for the ratio); R0_PregAtEntry is the delivered flag built from R0_CurrentPreg (D023, implied).
Applicability R002: not pregnant at baseline (R0_PregAtEntry = 0) means BMI and waist-hip ratio must not carry the not-applicable code; the source sets 9999 only when R0_CurrentPreg == 1 (D023).

Skip pattern R003: never pregnant or nulliparous (R0_Parous = -1 or 0, no live birth before entry) means age at first and last full-term pregnancy, breastfeeding duration and ever breastfed are structurally not applicable. Source: '9999 (NA) if no live-birth pregnancies or dates' (ages), '9999 (NA) if never a live-birth' (R0_Breastfed) (D024).

Applicability R003: parous (R0_Parous = 1) means ever breastfed and breastfeeding duration must not carry the not-applicable code. No applicability half for the two age fields: the source also gives them 9999 when dates are missing (D024).

Diabetes routing R004: age at diabetes diagnosis is kept only when diabetes status is Yes, so status No or Missing means the age is -999 (missing). Source (R0_AgeDiabetes x-description): 'only retained if R0_DiabetesStatus=1'; the source's only non-retained value is null, carried as -999. No reverse half: with status Yes the age may be a number or -999. D029.
